Bihar leaders clash over reservation, Tejashwi Yadav weighs in

Political leaders in Bihar, including Chirag Paswan and Jitan Ram Manjhi, have engaged in a public dispute concerning reservation policies. The conflict arose following statements made by Paswan and Manjhi, with Paswan advocating for dialogue to resolve reservation concerns. Tejashwi Yadav has also commented on the matter, framing the dispute as a potential attempt to undermine reservation. The debate touches upon the legacy of leaders like Karpoori Thakur and historical reservation policies in Bihar.
